en.headline: CLP and HK Electric raise September fuel charges amid energy volatility
en.dek: CLP’s fuel adjustment rises marginally to 45.1 cents per unit while HK Electric’s climbs 3.4 cents to 60.7 cents; both offer temporary rebates for lower-usage households.
body: Hong Kong’s two power companies will raise fuel-related charges from September, citing volatility in international energy markets and the lagged effect of earlier fuel costs.

CLP Power set its September fuel adjustment charge at 45.1 cents per unit, up 0.1 cent from August. The company is offering an eight-cent-per-unit special fuel rebate from August to October for residential customers using 900 units or fewer per billing cycle, bringing the effective charge for eligible households to 37.1 cents.

HK Electric raised its fuel clause charge by 3.4 cents, or 5.9 per cent, to 60.7 cents per unit. Together with the basic tariff, the average net tariff will rise to 188.6 cents. The company is providing an eight-cent-per-unit subsidy for residential customers using 450 units or fewer per month over the same three-month period.

zh.headline: 中電港燈9月燃料調整費上調 兩電推特別回扣紓緩
zh.dek: 中電燃料調整費微升至每度45.1仙，港燈升3.4仙至60.7仙；兩電均為低用量住宅客戶提供為期三個月的特別回扣或補助。
body: 本港兩間電力公司宣布9月燃料相關收費上調，主要反映國際能源市場波動及較早前燃料成本的遞延效應。
中電9月燃料調整費定為每度電45.1港仙，較8月微升0.1仙。公司由8月至10月為每期賬單用電量900度或以下的住宅客戶提供每度電8仙的燃料費特別回扣，合資格客戶實際燃料費降至37.1仙。
港燈燃料調整費上調3.4仙（5.9%）至每度60.7仙，連同基本電費後平均淨電費升至188.6仙。公司同期為每月用電量450度或以下的住宅客戶提供每度電8仙特別電費補助。
